phosphor.name: Phosphor (regular)
phosphor.note: outlined shapes on a 256 grid (about 1.5 on 24), soft round ends, friendly and open

lucide.name: Lucide
lucide.note: plain geometric strokes, 2 native, round caps, the closest to the reference

tabler.name: Tabler (outline)
tabler.note: geometric strokes, 2 native, a little more detail than Lucide, big catalogue

iconoir.name: Iconoir (regular)
iconoir.note: light strokes, 1.5 native, slightly rounded, editorial look

remix.name: Remix Icon (line)
remix.note: filled outlines, 2 on 24, firmer and squarer, some detail

solar.name: Solar (linear)
solar.note: light rounded strokes, 1.5 native; attribution required (already in the project, not permissive in the strict sense)

hugeicons.name: Hugeicons (free, stroke rounded)
hugeicons.note: round strokes, 1.5 native, slightly playful bodies, very large catalogue (gpu, fan, ram, memory stick)

mage.name: Mage Icons
mage.note: round strokes, 1.5 native, soft corners, clean and friendly

heroicons.name: Heroicons (outline)
heroicons.note: round strokes, 1.5 native, plain and neutral, Tailwind house style

proicons.name: ProIcons
proicons.note: round strokes, 1.5 native, slightly rounded, modern, includes window-restore

mynaui.name: Myna UI Icons
mynaui.note: round strokes, 1.5 native, rounded bodies, compact

humbleicons.name: Humbleicons
humbleicons.note: round strokes, 2 native, small and simple, modest detail

akar-icons.name: Akar Icons
akar-icons.note: round strokes, 2 native, large live area, slightly squarish bodies

system-uicons.name: System UIcons
system-uicons.note: very thin strokes (1 on a 21 grid, about 1.1 on 24 natively), light and technical; public domain dedication, not MIT/ISC/Apache/CC0 by name

charm.name: Charm Icons
charm.note: 1.5 native on a 16 grid, angular, square corners in the original (joins are rounded here), sharp and technical

f7.name: Framework7 Icons
f7.note: SF Symbols look, filled outlines on a 56 grid (about 1.7 on 24), fixed weight

uil.name: Unicons (line)
uil.note: filled outlines, about 2 on 24, dense, a little heavy, fixed weight

octicon.name: Octicons (24)
octicon.note: GitHub house style, filled outlines, about 1.5 on 24, fixed weight
